主要内容: Glencore Plc, the world’s biggest commodities trader, is testing the limits of U.S. sanctions by resuming payments to its longtime partner in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Dan Gertler, without public approval from U.S. authorities. This move is part of an effort to maintain access to valuable mining assets. The decision came days after a $150 million settlement with Congo’s state-owned miner and the debt restructuring of Glencore’s local subsidiary.
